title: Agronomic Intelligence
description: Web-based agronomic and geospatial screening for any location in Indonesia: soil profile, ERA5 rainfall normals, and a six-month climate outlook.

title: Sugarcane TCH Forecast
description: Walk-forward Sentinel-2 forecast of tonnes of cane per hectare with about 10% MAPE using a one-component PLS model and mid-season drought signals.

title: Oil Palm Leaf Nutrient Status
description: XGBoost classification of leaf N, P, K, and Mg status from 325–1075 nm spectra against oil-palm critical thresholds, with 66–81% cross-validated accuracy.
